name: Stonefire Tavern
summary: In Ironforge’s Commons, travelers find the Stonefire Tavern just north of the city gates. Its hearth, dwarven ale, and rooms offer rest to those arriving from across Khaz Modan.

sections.title: Heart of the Commons
sections.body:
In Ironforge’s Commons, just north of the fortress gates, Innkeeper Firebrew runs Stonefire Tavern with his daughter Gwenna. Weary wayfarers can find meals, local brews, and lodging beneath the mountain.

Travelers come from across the Alliance to rest from Dun Morogh’s mountain snows, trade tales, or gather supplies before exploring the city. The hearth draws them together at the heart of the Commons.

faq.q: Where is the Stonefire Tavern located?
faq.answer: Stonefire Tavern sits in Ironforge’s Commons, a short walk north of the main city gates.
Innkeeper Firebrew runs Stonefire Tavern with help from his daughter, Gwenna Firebrew.

faq.q: Can travelers bind their hearthstones here?
faq.answer: Yes. Innkeeper Firebrew lets Alliance travelers make Stonefire Tavern their home base in Ironforge.
A city mailbox stands just outside the entrance. Banks, merchants, and trade supplies are close by in the Commons.

angles.text: As a dwarf returning from across Khaz Modan, you can stop at Stonefire Tavern for a cold pint of Firebrew ale and local gossip.
As an Alliance traveler, you’ll find Stonefire Tavern near Ironforge’s front gates, a gathering place when visiting the dwarven capital.
